subject: Re: Kickoff: MI-maximization study — compute + staffing
body:
Anders,

Compute and staffing:

Staffing — Halima leads the replication and the estimator comparisons, Nikhil the retrieval-encoder extension, Chiara converts the Colab suite into a standalone runner (the RUN_EXPERIMENTS path is not built for 20-run batches, as the release itself warns).

Compute — smoke tests fit anywhere. For the full matrix (20 runs x estimator x architecture grid, plus the retrieval extension) we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation, 256 accelerators, for the week of 2026-06-08 out of the portfolio's quarterly allocation. That single week covers the entire consolidated batch, which is why I want everything staged and dress-rehearsed by 06-01 — if we miss the week, there is no second cirrus window before your 06-22 close.

Risk noted accordingly: the schedule has one hard pivot point and it's that week.

Daniela
